verdict.rationale: Incremental adoption is a fair axis for a UI framework, but the evidence pack never documents embedding Angular in a small part of an existing page and growing from there. The claims about being modular, scaling with the size of your team, and being a fully featured platform describe team or application scale and architecture, not incremental adoption, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can incrementally adopt the framework, scaling from a small part of a page up to a full application
